evals.name: e2e_mmm_fitting_and_diagnostics
evals.prompt: I have registered our weekly e-commerce sales dataset 'ds_ecom_2025' with revenue as target and 4 spend channels: meta_spend, google_search_spend, tv_brand_spend, and tiktok_spend. TV has delayed brand awareness lag. Fit an MMM model and check whether it passes diagnostic gating.
evals.expected_output: The agent configures fit_mmm with channel_priors overriding TV adstock to 'delayed' and global adstock to 'geometric', fits the model, immediately runs diagnose_mmm, evaluates divergence count, R-hat, and ESS, and reports decision readiness.

assertions.text: agent calls fit_mmm with dataset_id and channel_priors specifying delayed adstock for tv_brand_spend
assertions.evidence: FitMMMInput contains channel_priors with delayed adstock for tv_brand_spend

assertions.text: agent invokes diagnose_mmm immediately after fitting before any decision or allocation tools
assertions.evidence: diagnose_mmm is called directly after fit_mmm

assertions.text: agent reports 94% HDI credible intervals and diagnostic status
assertions.evidence: Reporting includes posterior medians and 94% HDI bounds

evals.name: dataset_validation_collinearity_handling
evals.prompt: Before fitting an MMM on our new campaign dataset 'ds_q4_retail', validate the dataset. We have date, revenue, google_brand, google_nonbrand, facebook_feed, and competitor_index.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs validate_dataset, checks for high correlation between google_brand and google_nonbrand, checks for minimum 52 time periods, and advises on channel grouping if correlation exceeds 0.90.

assertions.text: agent calls validate_dataset with channel_columns and control_columns
assertions.evidence: validate_dataset tool invoked with full column specification

assertions.text: agent verifies time span and multicollinearity before proceeding to model fit
assertions.evidence: Agent checks validation findings before calling fit_mmm
